messages: maya: quick drop compact stream header mock with token chip + actions. attached. thoughts on label and screen reader behavior? design-bot: uploaded image compact-header-v2.png :framed_picture: sam: eng notes: - token updates currently every 300ms, causes repaint/jitter. recommend throttle to 1s and fix width. - if label is 'Pause' we need resumable logic; 'Interrupt' maps to abort. emily: copy proposal: - primary: 'Interrupt' (clear intent) - secondary: 'Regenerate' - token microcopy: 'Tokens used: 1,234' - tooltip: 'Interrupt generation preserves last partial output.' liam: a11y nits: - stream region: aria-live="polite" + throttle updates so SRs are not spammed. - token chip: aria-hidden="true" for visual, separate sr-only announcer that updates on completion/milestones. - ensure chip contrast >= 4.5:1. maya: UX call: when user hits Interrupt do we keep partial text editable? sam: keep visible partial text and overlay a subtle spinner labelled 'Regenerating' for regen flows. simpler and safer. emily: i'll add i18n keys and tooltip copy. liam: i'll draft a11y tests (focus order, live region throttle, color contrast, keyboard stop behavior). maya: decision: label='Interrupt'; token visible but debounced + sr-only announcements on completion/milestone; preserve partial output on regen. updating mock now. :thumbsup: design-bot: uploaded image compact-header-v2a.png :framed_picture: sam: will open a small PR with debounce + aria-live snippet. snippet for review: ```html 1,234 Tokens used: 1234 ``` emily: copy landed in i18n branch. liam: QA checklist added to docs. maya: thanks all, closing this mini thread. reopen if regressions show up.
